question_text: Construct Python function estimate(kind, count), where kind is "small" or "large" and count is a valid positive integer. Land costs 500000. Small units sell for 220000, need 17 days and 100000 materials each; large units sell for 400000, need 23 days and 190000 materials each. Labour costs 2500 per day. Units are built sequentially. Return revenue minus all costs.
